# WattSteer

> WattSteer predicts renewable curtailment on the Brazilian grid a day ahead,
> explains the grid conditions associated with it, and estimates how much of it
> storage or flexible demand could absorb.

WattSteer is a public, read-only site built on openly published data from ONS
(Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico), ANEEL and weather providers. It has no
accounts and no login.

## Languages

The site is published in two locales, and the URL is what selects one — there
is no per-request negotiation and no client-side language state to reason
about. `/pt/…` is Portuguese (pt-BR) and `/en/…` is English; the same page
exists at both prefixes and each declares the other as an `hreflang`
alternate. Portuguese is the default and the `x-default` target: the audience
is Brazilian grid operators and renewable IPPs, and the data is ONS's.

`https://wattsteer.com/` itself is only a language gate — `noindex,follow`,
with links to both roots. It is not a page worth reading; follow it through to
one of the two below.

## Pages

Portuguese (pt-BR):

- [Início](https://wattsteer.com/pt/): risco de curtailment por subsistema para
  o dia seguinte, os quatro motores por trás dele e a origem dos dados.
- [Termos de Uso](https://wattsteer.com/pt/terms)
- [Política de Privacidade](https://wattsteer.com/pt/privacy)

English:

- [Home](https://wattsteer.com/en/): day-ahead curtailment risk by subsystem,
  the four engines behind it, and where the data comes from.
- [Terms of Service](https://wattsteer.com/en/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://wattsteer.com/en/privacy)

Locale-independent:

- [App](https://wattsteer.com/app): the product itself — Grid Overview,
  Explain, Mitigate and Time Machine. Not locale-prefixed and `noindex`; its
  language follows the visitor's stored preference.

## Notes

- Headline figures are quantiles, not point estimates. Every forecast is
  published as P10, P50 and P90; a figure shown without a band is a measured
  observation and is labelled as one.
- The four subsystems are NORTE, NORDESTE, SUL and SUDESTE/CENTRO-OESTE. A
  national figure is a derived sum over those four, never the ONS `SIN` row.
- Energy is reported in MWh. Money appears only as an explicitly labelled
  economic scenario, next to the R$/MWh it assumed. No carbon figure is
  claimed.
- Sector vocabulary is not translated in either locale: "curtailment",
  "constrained-off" and "conjunto" appear verbatim in Portuguese and English
  alike, because that is how the sector's own Portuguese-language discourse
  uses them.
- Forecasts are modelled estimates carrying uncertainty, not operating
  instructions, trading signals or advice.
- Source data is published by third parties and is periodically revised; figures
  shown here can change. Metrics computed over windows that predate WattSteer's
  own ingestion are labelled revision-optimistic.
- Plant registry data is derived from ANEEL SIGA, © ANEEL, under the Open
  Database License (ODbL) v1.0; WattSteer's derived plant table is offered
  under the same licence.
- WattSteer is not affiliated with ONS or ANEEL.
